answer_contracts.category: Server-declared finite choices; labels specify the actual mathematical classification.
answer_contracts.limit_result: Tagged finite exact real value, positive infinity, negative infinity or does-not-exist; compare the finite expression only in the finite branch.
answer_contracts.logic: Bounded propositional syntax with declared atoms; compare full truth tables, not natural-language semantics.
answer_contracts.periodic_set: Finite union of canonical base-period points/intervals plus integer translates and excluded poles.
answer_contracts.region: Bounded declared family of real-coordinate inequalities, intersections/unions and exclusions; check whole region, not its radius.
answer_contracts.series: Declared indexed coefficient expression, start/parity/index and exact convergence set; not an arbitrary Sum parser.
answer_contracts.ode_family: Declared explicit/implicit solution family with arbitrary constants, branches/equilibria and maximal real intervals.
answer_contracts.iterated_bounds: Ordered finite pieces with integration variable order, exact outer/inner bounds and preserved integrand.
